text:
sara: Heads up — we should bump the redwood-cache StatefulSet replicas from 3 -> 5 before next week’s traffic spike. Also want to switch updateStrategy to RollingUpdate with a partition so we can stagger restarts. Where should this change live — Terraform (infra repo) or the Helm chart?

mike: replicas are controlled in the infra terraform module (modules/k8s-statefulset). Helm chart has a default too but infra overrides it via kubernetes_stateful_set resource. Do it in TF so state stays in one place.

jess: Agree with mike. If you’re changing replicas in TF, also bump container resources (we saw OOMs on pod 2 last week). Quick sample of the StatefulSet snippet we want to end up with — updateStrategy + readiness probe to avoid mass churn:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redwood-cache
spec:
  serviceName: redwood-cache-svc
  replicas: 5
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      partition: 2  # leave pods 0-1 untouched, roll 2+ first
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: cache
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: "300m"
            memory: "768Mi"
          limits:
            cpu: "600m"
            memory: "1Gi"
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /healthz
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 5
```

mike: Terraform snippet (modules/k8s-statefulset/main.tf) — mirror these fields via the kubernetes provider blocks. e.g.:

```hcl
resource "kubernetes_stateful_set" "cache" {
  metadata { name = "redwood-cache" }
  spec {
    replicas = var.cache_replicas
    update_strategy {
      type = "RollingUpdate"
      rolling_update { partition = var.cache_update_partition }
    }
    template {
      spec {
        container {
          name  = "cache"
          image = var.cache_image
          resources {
            requests = { cpu = "300m" , memory = "768Mi" }
            limits   = { cpu = "600m" , memory = "1Gi" }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

infra-bot: terraform plan started by @mike — running in infra/terraform (PR #623) :gear:

sara: I’ll open the TF PR to set var.cache_replicas = 5 and also wire the TLS secret mount for the cache sidecar (secret currently named cache-tls in staging). Can someone confirm the secret key name?

jess: TLS secret key is `tls.crt` / `tls.key` in cache-tls. When you mount, use projected volume with secretRef to avoid accidental env leak. Also note: StatefulSet RollingUpdate doesn’t support maxUnavailable; use partition plus proper readinessProbe.

mike: Also add a PodDisruptionBudget so k8s won’t evict too many:

```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: redwood-cache-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redwood-cache
```

And add a preStop hook to the container to wait for slow drains.
